bullets.text: FA Cup Excitement Ahead! - **Charlton** faces **Chelsea** in a thrilling cup clash on January 10.
iOS 26 Screenshot Overhaul - New **Apple Intelligence** features enhance screenshot functionality in iOS 26.
iPhone Air 2 Upgrades Incoming - **Apple** plans to enhance camera and battery life in the upcoming iPhone Air 2.
Anker's Nano Charger Innovation - New **Anker** charger features a display but lacks functionality with Android devices.
Apple Store Closure Alert - **Apple's** flagship Regent Street store in London to close for refurbishments next week.
AI-Driven Shopping Future - **Google** unveils a new protocol to enhance commerce using AI agents.
Drone Delivery Expansion - **Wing** partners with **Walmart** to expand drone delivery to 150 more stores.
AI Medical Overviews Removed - **Google** pulls AI-generated medical overviews after misleading information concerns.
Health App Revamp Coming - **Apple** to launch a redesigned Health app with new features in iOS 26.4.
Instagram Security Update - **Instagram** resolves issues that triggered multiple password reset emails.
